reviewStandard: The six queued routes failed the pre-generation cell-state nomenclature, molecular-identity, functional-phenotype, immunological-causality, low-biomass community, glycosylation-scope, or representation gate. They received no marked prompt, no built-in generation call, and no raster. Controlled records and primary-indexed reviews were checked against the generated article corpus; conflicts and required resolution are preserved in the audit and review packets. Zero hashes are eligible for promotion.
promotionRule: No Batch 083 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its documented identity, scope, representation, evidence, analytical, causal, and nomenclature conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Heterogeneous context-dependent cell states are reduced to M1/M2 polarity and a universal metal-gut-brain neurodegeneration mediator.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Specify species, age, region, model, cell markers, state data, exposure dose/route/time, comparator, and measured function using current nomenclature.

routeDecisions.reason: Protein metalation, ionic mimicry, transport competition, toxicology, host defense, exposure biomarkers, and proposed treatments are conflated.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by protein/accession, organism/compartment, cognate and competing species, site/stoichiometry, availability, assay, phenotype, and in-vivo evidence.

routeDecisions.reason: Many organelles, tissues, assays, toxicants, diseases, and cell-death mechanisms are presented as one measurable causal pathway.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define tissue/cell/model, perturbation, dose/time, respiratory substrate and assay, membrane potential, redox/morphology/quality-control measures, comparator, and causal intervention.

routeDecisions.reason: One established infection association and several proposed microbiome links are presented together as a primary causal mechanism without epitope-level proof.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Document foreign and self epitopes, structural/sequence similarity, HLA, cross-reactivity assay, cohort, epidemiology, model transfer, and alternatives for each example.

routeDecisions.reason: Body-site, transient, colonizing, pathogenic, and low-biomass fungal signals are merged with strong disease and functional claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define body site, specimen, biomass controls, method, primers/database, absolute burden, viability/residency, taxon resolution, confounders, replication, and function.

routeDecisions.reason: Eukaryotic, bacterial, fungal, host-protein, microbial-protein, and glycome-association findings are conflated, including an unsupported metal-dependent enzyme claim.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Select organism, compartment, substrate/site, glycan structure, enzyme/pathway identifiers, analytical method, phenotype, and evidence; remove or substantiate metal dependence.
